key.name: open-editor
key.summary: Open the editor after a screenshot
key.description: Open screenshots taken with Print or the quick-settings screenshot button in the annotation editor.

key.name: play-sound
key.description: When off, GNOME's screenshot sound is muted for every screenshot, including Shift+Print and Alt+Print. Other system sounds are not affected.

key.name: keep-screenshots
key.description: When off, a screenshot opened in the editor is deleted from the Screenshots folder when the editor closes, unless it was saved. Save then writes over GNOME's file instead of creating a "-edited" copy.

key.name: close-after-copy
key.description: Copy (Ctrl+C) also closes the editor window.
